name: Exercise Physiology
summary: How the body responds and adapts to physical activity: energy systems, cardiorespiratory limits, training and performance.

topics.name: Energy systems: phosphocreatine, glycolytic and oxidative
VO2max, lactate threshold and exercise testing
Cardiovascular and respiratory responses to exercise
Hormonal and thermoregulatory responses to exercise
Principles of training: overload, specificity and periodisation
Metabolic cost of locomotion and economy of movement
Environmental exercise physiology: heat, cold, altitude
Detraining, bed rest and inactivity physiology
